name: create-company-deck
description: Build a high-quality self-contained HTML slide deck for a named company from three inputs — its company overview, its DESIGN.md design tokens, and a source document or prompt — assembling slides from a bundled library of proven layout templates and generating photography with the media-gen-pro MCP. Use whenever someone wants a deck, slides, a presentation, a quarterly or results deck, an investor update, a board pack or a strategy deck built for a specific company, especially when they hand over a company overview, brand tokens and an announcement or brief and ask for slides from them. Carries a generated theme block derived from the company's own type ramp by a single ratio, fifteen filled-and-numbered slide layouts, the figure-ledger and zero-based-axis discipline a disclosure-derived deck needs, media-gen-pro prompt and grade-lock recipes with the never-a-real-person rule, and a measured gate suite for four render failures that are invisible in a screenshot — stage clipping, print containing-block collapse, copy painted under a full-bleed image, and pinned chrome stretched by the wrapper-collapse guard. Supplies its own missing inputs — company-overview-from-website crawls the overview and design-md-from-website measures the DESIGN.md off the same site — so a company URL plus a source document is enough to start, and hands the built deck to design-review before completion. Carries a Diolog studio-runner target (references/eve-runner.md) so the same grounding governs decks authored as diolog.deck-source/1 deck.json by the Eve agent, where the HTML shell and scripts do not apply. Not for a .pptx or editable Office handoff (deck-craft's lecturn JSON target), an investor portal page (create-investor-portal-free), or a deck with no brand and no source material (deck-craft's direction round).
